### The Confidence to Pray Bold Prayers
Author: Kia Stephens
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-decermber-26-2019.html
Passage: Acts 3:6
Points:
- Deep personal crises and addiction cannot be resolved by money or quick fixes.
- The beggar was positioned right outside the temple yet asked only for pocket change.
- Peter invoked the character and divine authority of Jesus rather than material wealth.
- The life-transforming power found in the name of Jesus remains active today.
- Believers are invited to pray bold prayers over situations that appear hopeless.

### Day 229: Acts 3:1–10
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-229-acts-3-110.html
Passage: Acts 3:1-10
Points:
- Peter and John did not let religious schedules keep them from noticing someone in need.
- The apostles looked directly at the beggar rather than turning away from misery.
- God calls believers to share what they have instead of worrying about what they lack.
- Peter reached out his hand to offer personal support and faith to help the man stand.
- The apostles refused to take credit for the miracle, pointing all attention to God.
